reported_locus_or_element: Open chromatin overlapping fine-mapped variants at 82 COPD loci
tissue_or_cell_context: Primary large-airway and small-airway epithelial cells, AT2 cells, lung fibroblasts, and 16HBE
target_gene_or_program: Candidate targets included TNPO1 and locus-proximal genes; target assignment remained largely predictive
target_linkage_evidence: Fine mapping plus OCR overlap and cell-specific deltaSVM; 250 variants overlapped an OCR and 22 also had significant predicted sequence effects
disease_or_trait_linkage: COPD GWAS; chromatin maps were generated primarily in nondiseased cells
functional_test: No new perturbation in this study; rs2013701 served as a positive comparator from COPD-SRC-044
interpretation_and_limitations: Useful cell-context prior, not disease-altered chromatin and not proof of an enhancer-target pair

reported_locus_or_element: Fourth-intron FAM13A regulatory sequences within an approximately 100-kb LD block; key variant rs2013701
target_linkage_evidence: 3C contact with the FAM13A promoter, human-lung eQTL concordance, and endogenous expression change after allele editing
disease_or_trait_linkage: Two independent COPD association signals in a case-control GWAS region
functional_test: MPRA, allele-specific luciferase, 3C, and CRISPR/Cas9 homology editing of rs2013701; proliferation phenotype measured
interpretation_and_limitations: Strongest variant-to-target evidence in this set; cell-line context and clonal editing still warrant primary-cell replication

reported_locus_or_element: Approximately 2.4-kb enhancer region approximately 85 kb upstream of HHIP, narrowed to an approximately 500-bp minimal element containing rs6537296 and rs1542725
tissue_or_cell_context: BEAS-2B bronchial epithelial and MRC5 lung fibroblast cell lines; COPD lung expression follow-up
target_linkage_evidence: Long-range 3C contact with the HHIP promoter; COPD-risk haplotype reduced reporter output; rs1542725-C increased binding of the Sp3 repressor
disease_or_trait_linkage: Variants associated with severe COPD in smoking cases and controls; HHIP RNA and protein lower in COPD lung
functional_test: Bidirectional reporter assays, 3C, and allele-specific EMSA; no endogenous allele edit
interpretation_and_limitations: Direct molecular support for the haplotype and target, but endogenous allele causality was not tested and whole-lung HHIP expression is composition-sensitive

phenotype_scope: COPD and lung-function GWAS locus; advanced-COPD chromatin context
reported_locus_or_element: Human-specific T2 element within the broad chr4:144,579,000-144,586,000 GRCh38 distal region, approximately 60 kb from the HHIP promoter
element_type: H3K27ac-marked, accessible distal enhancer and topological-boundary element
tissue_or_cell_context: Advanced-COPD distal-lung snATAC, public healthy-lung scATAC, BEAS-2B, primary NHBE, and iPSC-derived AT2 cells
target_gene_or_program: HHIP; baseline expression and TGF-beta/SMAD3 response
target_linkage_evidence: H3K27ac, reporter activity, 3C/Hi-C promoter contact, and loss of HHIP after deleting a less-than-500-bp T2 segment
disease_or_trait_linkage: Located within the 4q31 GWAS locus, but the paper states that no GWAS variant lies directly inside T2
functional_test: CRISPR deletion in BEAS-2B and primary-cell models; local topology, HHIP expression, and TGF-beta response tested
interpretation_and_limitations: Strong enhancer-to-target evidence but not a functionally tested risk variant; COPD snATAC involved three advanced cases

tissue_or_cell_context: 16HBE, MRC5, HUVEC screening; 16HBE and primary NHBE follow-up
target_linkage_evidence: Allele-sensitive MPRA and reporter output plus reduced target expression after CRISPRi of the variant-containing region
disease_or_trait_linkage: Variant drawn from a COPD GWAS locus
functional_test: MPRA across 1,120 variants, reporter validation, and two-guide CRISPRi in 16HBE and primary NHBE
interpretation_and_limitations: CRISPRi establishes region-to-gene regulation, not which rs35421223 allele drives endogenous expression; ahead-of-print article as of the evidence cutoff

phenotype_scope: Shared asthma, cystic-fibrosis, and COPD modifier evidence
element_type: H3K27ac/H3K4me1-marked enhancer-like region with nearby CTCF insulation
tissue_or_cell_context: A549, H292, H441 epithelial lines and primary human lung fibroblasts
target_gene_or_program: TGFB1; weak B9D2 effect in one line
target_linkage_evidence: Hi-C/eQTL prediction plus target-expression reduction when the region was CRISPRi-repressed
disease_or_trait_linkage: Not a COPD-only case-control locus; labeled a shared lung-disease modifier by the source
functional_test: Lentiviral and synthetic-guide CRISPRi of the variant-containing region
interpretation_and_limitations: Supports an enhancer region controlling TGFB1, but does not test alternate alleles and should not be counted as COPD-specific variant causality

phenotype_scope: Shared asthma and COPD modifier evidence
target_linkage_evidence: Hi-C/eQTL prediction plus expression reduction after region CRISPRi
functional_test: Synthetic-guide CRISPRi of the variant-containing region
interpretation_and_limitations: Multi-gene region effect is experimentally supported, but allele specificity, primary-cell replication, and COPD specificity are absent

element_type: DNA-methylation-sensitive enhancer; H3K4me1 and RNA-polymerase-II occupancy assayed
tissue_or_cell_context: Differentiated normal and COPD-derived primary airway epithelial cells; human precision-cut lung slices
target_linkage_evidence: Enhancer-D hypermethylation associated with reduced RNA-polymerase-II occupancy and CDH1; promoter methylation was not different
disease_or_trait_linkage: Enhancer methylation and expression compared directly in COPD and normal donor cells
functional_test: Global 5-aza demethylation restored enhancer occupancy, CDH1, and barrier phenotypes and improved COPD-slice damage measures
interpretation_and_limitations: Compelling locus-focused mechanism, but the pharmacologic perturbation is genome-wide and does not prove enhancer D is the sole mediator

reported_locus_or_element: 6,279 COPD-associated DMRs in purified lung fibroblasts, enriched in regulatory chromatin; 4,424 DMRs linked by proximity to 4,059 genes
element_type: Differentially methylated regulatory regions, including enhancer and super-enhancer overlaps
tissue_or_cell_context: Purified primary parenchymal lung fibroblasts across GOLD stages
target_gene_or_program: Seventy-seven DMR-associated DEGs; broader proliferation, DNA-repair, and extracellular-matrix programs
target_linkage_evidence: WGBS-RNA integration, proximity mapping, motif analysis, and overlap with fibroblast enhancer annotations
disease_or_trait_linkage: COPD-stage differential methylation in a cell-enriched preparation
functional_test: siRNA phenotypic screening tested nominated genes, not the DMRs themselves
interpretation_and_limitations: Supports fibroblast-intrinsic epigenetic remodeling; individual DMR-to-target links remain associative and sample sizes were small

reported_locus_or_element: 1,260 differentially methylated CpG probes representing 1,120 genes; HM27 design was mainly promoter-proximal
element_type: Differentially methylated CpG sites, predominantly hypermethylated
target_gene_or_program: PTEN, CSNK2A2, EPHX1, CYP4F11, and coordinated PTEN/NRF2/IL-17F programs
target_linkage_evidence: Matched methylation-expression correlation and selected pyrosequencing validation
disease_or_trait_linkage: Direct COPD versus smoking-history-matched control comparison
interpretation_and_limitations: Relevant airway compartment and matched assays, but array coverage, epithelial subtype composition, and lack of perturbation prevent enhancer-target or causal claims

phenotype_scope: COPD case-control with severity and emphysema integration
reported_locus_or_element: Differential methylation and network features nominating EPAS1
element_type: DNA-methylation-associated regulatory network; no single enhancer established
target_linkage_evidence: Integrated methylation-expression-network inference; COPD lung EPAS1 protein validation; endothelial EPAS1 knockdown
disease_or_trait_linkage: Direct COPD-control lung comparison with overlap to severity-related gene sets
functional_test: EPAS1 siRNA tested gene function, not a specific methylated element
interpretation_and_limitations: Supports EPAS1 biology but does not identify a causal enhancer; bulk cell composition and emphysema correlation are major alternative explanations

phenotype_scope: COPD case-control in the lower airway
reported_locus_or_element: 1,155 Bonferroni-significant BAL-cell DMPs; 79 correlated with expression and 39 percent colocated with COPD-GWAS SNPs
tissue_or_cell_context: Mixed bronchoalveolar-lavage cells from 18 COPD and 15 smoking controls
target_gene_or_program: Genes included transcription-factor and immune/regulatory programs; correlations were assessed in a separate BAL expression dataset
target_linkage_evidence: EWAS, pathway analysis, cross-dataset methylation-expression correlation, and positional GWAS colocation
disease_or_trait_linkage: Direct COPD-control comparison, but colocation means physical overlap rather than statistical colocalization
interpretation_and_limitations: Strong statistical association in a disease-relevant compartment, but immune-cell composition, separate expression cohorts, and no causal test limit target claims
